newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email says 1st quarter profit higher.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email says 1st quarter profit higher.

text.p: Household appliances group Email Ltd said on Friday its first quarter profit was higher than in the same quarter a year ago and the group continued to expect higher first profits in the half year to September 30.
"The company is expecting an increased profit, but the degree of improvement will be influenced by prevailing economic conditions," Email Chairman Peter Cottrell told the group's annual meeting.
Email Managing Director John Hanna told the meeting two industrial disputes at the company's Victorian operations had an adverse impact on sales and profits in the first quarter.
However, he said, much of the effect was expected to be recovered during the course of the year.
